summary: This is a Detectron2 configuration file for training RetinaNet with Synchronized BatchNorm on the head. It contains only module-level variable assignments — no functions, classes, or callable APIs.
description: Configures a RetinaNet model with SyncBatchNorm2d on the head, COCO dataloader, SGD optimizer (lr=0.01), 3x learning rate schedule, and 270k training iterations starting from an ImageNet-pretrained R-50 checkpoint.
config_variables: model — RetinaNet model with backbone frozen at stage 2, head norm set to SyncBatchNorm2d
lr_multiplier — 3x learning rate schedule for COCO
optimizer — SGD optimizer with learning rate 0.01
train — training config with R-50 ImageNet pretrained checkpoint and 270000 max iterations

examples.review_retinanet_syncbn_config: review the python config file that sets up RetinaNet with SyncBatchNorm2d on the head for COCO training
examples.summarize_retinanet_config: summarize the python config file that configures RetinaNet with SGD optimizer and 270k training iterations
examples.create_retinanet_syncbn_config: create a python config file that configures RetinaNet with SyncBatchNorm2d on the head using get_config
examples.build_retinanet_training_config: build a python config that sets RetinaNet backbone freeze_at=2 with an R-50 ImageNet pretrained checkpoint
examples.refactor_retinanet_optimizer: refactor the python config to change the SGD optimizer learning rate from 0.01 to a different value
